title: ‘We're close, I know that:' Jonathan Greenard unsure if he's playing Sunday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: ‘We're close, I know that:' Jonathan Greenard unsure if he's playing Sunday
sources.description: Howie Roseman's centerpiece of the Eagles' offseason returned to practice this week but there's still uncertainty if the edge rusher will play Sunday.
